title: AgentDiff: Meaning-Bearing Rewrites Trigger Deeper Divergence than Presentation Changes in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.25981v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents should respond to what an input means, not how it is presented. We show that they do not treat these two kinds of variation equally. AgentDiff measures the difference between answer changes caused by meaning-bearing rewrites (paraphrase and synonym substitution) and presentation changes (reordering, formatting, and distractors), while matching perturbation severity. Across 68 model--benchmark--scaffold cells spanning ten LLMs from seven architecture families, three benchmarks, 1{,}530 original questions, and approximately 11{,}150 variants, meaning-bearing rewrites produce a $+19.69$ percentage-point higher inconsistency rate (paired $t=9.58$, $p<0.0001$; 64/68 cells positive). The result is stable under four severity proxies ($+18.9$ to $+20.9$~pp, all $p<0.0001$) and remains $+11.10$~pp on the 48 cells outside the qwen family. translated_title: AgentDiff：在LLM智能体中，意义承载的改写比呈现方式变化引发更深层次的差异
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体应响应输入的含义，而非其呈现方式。我们表明，它们对这两种变化并未同等对待。AgentDiff衡量了由意义承载的改写（如释义和同义词替换）与呈现方式变化（如重排序、格式化和干扰项）引起的答案差异，同时匹配扰动严重性。在跨越七个架构家族的十个LLM、三个基准、1,530个原始问题及约11,150个变体的68个模型-基准-脚手架组合中，意义承载的改写导致不一致率高出19.69个百分点（配对t=9.58，p<0.0001；64/68个组合为正）。该结果在四种严重性代理指标下保持稳定（+18.9至+20.9个百分点，所有p<0.0001），并且在qwen家族之外的48个组合中仍高出11.10个百分点。一个完全留出的qwen2.5-14B-Instruct评估随后测试了这种效应在1,000个问题上的结构。
tldr: 本文提出AgentDiff方法，发现LLM智能体对意义承载的改写比呈现方式变化产生显著更高的答案不一致率，表明它们更敏感于语义变化而非表面形式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentDiff, revealing that LLM agents exhibit significantly higher answer inconsistency for meaning-bearing rewrites than presentation changes, indicating greater sensitivity to semantic shifts over surface form.
